label: No all-subsets probability measure invariant under every permutation
paraphrase: On an infinite carrier with every subset measurable, no Mathlib probability is invariant under all carrier permutations; its finite real set values would contradict the finitely additive result. The all-subsets hypothesis is essential: on an uncountable carrier the countable/co-countable probability measure is permutation-invariant on its restricted sigma-algebra.
